image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vertical traffic light suspended against a clear blue sky. The traffic light housing is dark gray/black with three circular lenses stacked vertically: red (top, illuminated), amber/yellow (middle, unlit but visible), and green (bottom, illuminated). Each lens has a textured, faceted surface typical of LED or prismatic lenses. Visors (hoods) extend over each lens. The unit is mounted to a horizontal mast arm via a bracket on the left side. Wires are visible in the background.
